description: Asleep start restoring the last known values including the software version: twin of vehicle_start_asleep with a seeded position row (as in the seed self-test) and a seeded update row (version 2026.20.1 abc123). The first fetch finds the car asleep with a bare payload; restore_last_known_values/2 rebuilds the last response from the position row and reads car_version from the latest update row, so the version topic shows 2026.20.1 without any API payload carrying it — next to the position-derived topics. One open asleep row; the asleep terminal repeats through the probe without writing.
